intro: Hi, I'm Evan. I currently live in Shanghai.
Welcome to my personal website. Here I share my work, the projects I'm building, and some of the things I enjoy in everyday life.
career: I studied statistics at Beihang University and went on to earn a master's degree in statistics at Columbia University in the United States. Since graduating, I've worked on AI algorithms. As large language models have evolved, my focus has gradually shifted from machine learning to AI agents.

In the early years of my career, I worked mainly on demand forecasting, operations research and optimization, and computer vision. I later moved into large language model applications, with a focus on post-training and bringing AI agents into production.
Outside work, I aspire to be an independent developer and use AI to build products that interest me.
interests: I'm also a dedicated fan of anime, comics, and games.

I love anime—I keep my own library and collect new shows each season—and games across PlayStation, Switch, PC, and mobile, especially JRPGs. I also enjoy anisong, including anime idols, bands, and Vocaloid, as well as J-pop. I often go to concerts by my favorite artists and bands and to anime-related live events. Occasionally I play anisong on the piano, and I play badminton every week.
about.closing: On the following pages, you'll find my professional experience and projects, along with anime, games, and music I'd like to recommend. If we share these interests, I hope you'll find something that resonates with you.

paragraphs: My career began in machine learning and has gradually moved toward AI agents alongside the development of large language models. Early on, I researched and developed algorithms for demand forecasting, operations research and optimization, and computer vision, gaining practical experience in data mining, feature engineering, tree models, neural network training, and optimizing algorithms in production. In recent years, I've focused on LLM applications, contributing to model post-training, prompt engineering, query understanding, tool calling, and LLM evaluation, and bringing those capabilities into products, model training, and production systems.

Outside my day job, I hope to grow as an independent developer and keep building AI products of my own. I believe AI improves productivity and steadily lowers the barrier to creating value. More people will use it to learn, create, research, and invest, and more will use it to build their own products. I enjoy taking an idea through product design, data, algorithms, engineering, and launch, and I want to keep building products that solve real problems and that people continue using over time.
projects: An AI-assisted analysis product for individual investors, and an important part of my personal quantitative investing system. It uses large language models to interpret news, analyze investment reasoning and trends, explain performance, and assess portfolios.

Open-source infrastructure for distributed data collection. A Controller / Worker architecture coordinates tasks across RSS feeds, web pages, sitemaps, and JSON APIs, with built-in retries, recovery, historical backfills, and a visual dashboard.

An information aggregator for anime-related live events in Japan, covering anisong, J-pop, voice actors, anime idols, and more. It helps live-event fans keep track of performances by the artists they love.
